label: miso16 st gas intermediate
definition: MISO intermediate gas-steam structure on top of miso15 (--st-gas-intermediate): ST_GAS_INTERMEDIATE offer-curve cohort routing for the measured median-CF>=50 steam fleet (Harding Street, Ames, Nine Mile Pt, Lewis Creek, Sabine), ST_GAS startup-cost/min-run P1 bid markup (steam drags, not peaker-cycles), and ERCOT-fitted ST_GAS WEFOR base 0.21->0.10 (realistic gas-steam EFOR). Targets the Moselle/Lewis Creek ST under-run + peaker-like steam cycling. Net-load reliability drag floor (Little Gypsy weather must-run) deferred: ERCOT drag coefficients saturate at MISO net-load scale, needs MISO-specific derivation.
